paras: Upgrade your BMW's rear braking performance with Dixcel brake pads, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel pads are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel brake pad compounds shown for a wide range of BMW platforms including the 1 Series (F20) , 2 Series (F22/F23) , 3 Series (F30/F31/F34) , 4 Series (F32/F33/F36) , M135i/M140i (F20) , M235i/M240i (F22/F23) , M2/M2 Competition/M2 CS (F87) , M3/M3 30 Years Edition (F80) , and M4/M4 Competition/M4 CS/M4 GTS (F82/F83) . Multiple compound options are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the comparison chart on this product page to select the compound best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
